name: Orbmancy
description:
You are trained in the use of orbs, a special weapon type which requires attunement. Spending 1 hour attuning to an orb grants it the following properties:

  • Manifestation. The orb alters its appearance in some noticeable way and/or emits light or sound when you handle it. Choose the effect when you attune to the orb.

  • Rebounding. The orb is unnaturally bouncy, propelled away from objects and surfaces it contacts—except you.

  • Adherence. The orb clings lightly to you. Ignore its weight when calculating Load.

  • Reservoir. The orb automatically stores and releases MP as you gain, lose or spend it. All your current MP is stored in the orb when you attune to it, and the orb resets to holding your base MP after 1 minute spent out of combat.

  • Release. Whenever you attack and hit with the orb, it automatically releases all the MP it's storing. For each 1 MP released, +1d damage. After a hit, the orb automatically teleports back to you.

  • Recall. If you are not in contact with the orb but you are within its range and have at least one hand free, you may spend a half action to recall it to you. If you do, it teleports to your position, appearing in your hand(s).

These properties persist while you are attuned to the orb. You may only be attuned to one orb at a time. When you are not attuned to the orb, it is mundane and is considered an improvised weapon if used for an attack.

Regardless of whether you are attuned to it, when you attack and miss with an orb, it continues in the direction you threw it to the edge of its range, or until it is stopped by an object. It retains its charges of MP, if any.

Each orb has a Difficulty, which is used in some Orbmancer abilities and represents how difficult the orb is to handle due to weight, size, material or other properties.

Describe how you handle the orb.

improvements.name: Baller
improvements.description: You may maintain attunement with one additional orb.
